user.title: Heating & Cooling Degree Days
user.description: Set up Heating and Cooling Degree Days calculation. Enter the base temperature in {temperature_unit}.

data_description.name: Optional. Used as the entry title and device name. If left empty, a name is derived from the base temperature, e.g. "Heating Degree Days (18.0°C)".
data_description.base_temperature: The default base temperature is 18°C for Celsius or 65°F for Fahrenheit, depending on your unit system
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. A weather entity with hourly forecasts, used for today's and tomorrow's estimates. Clear it to remove the estimate sensors.

reconfigure.title: Heating & Cooling Degree Days
reconfigure.description: Change the degree days calculation settings. Enter the base temperature in {temperature_unit}, the unit saved for this entry.

data_description.name: Used as the entry title and device name. If left empty, a name is derived from the base temperature, e.g. “Heating Degree Days (18.0°C)”.
data_description.base_temperature: The unit saved for this entry is preserved when Home Assistant’s unit system changes.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. A weather entity with hourly forecasts, used for today's and tomorrow's estimates. Clear it to remove the estimate sensors.

error.invalid_temperature_sensor: Select an existing sensor with a temperature device class or a temperature unit (°C, °F or K).
error.invalid_base_temperature: Enter a finite number for the base temperature.
error.invalid_weather_entity: Select an existing weather entity that provides hourly forecasts.

abort.already_configured: An entry with this temperature sensor and base temperature already exists.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings updated. Stored daily values are reset when the temperature source, the base temperature or the unit changes.

missing_source.title: Temperature source missing: {name}
missing_source.description: The source sensor `{entity_id}` for {name} no longer exists. Previously calculated degree days are retained; missing days remain incomplete. Restore the source, or open [Heating & Cooling Degree Days]({url}), select the three-dot menu for this entry, and choose **Reconfigure** to select another temperature sensor.

weather_missing.title: Weather forecast source missing: {name}
weather_missing.description: The weather entity `{entity_id}` used for the degree-day estimates of {name} no longer exists. Historical sensors are not affected; estimates only include observed temperatures. Restore the entity, or open [Heating & Cooling Degree Days]({url}), select the three-dot menu for this entry, and choose **Reconfigure** to select another weather entity or remove it.

forecast_unsupported.title: Hourly forecasts unavailable: {name}
forecast_unsupported.description: The weather entity `{entity_id}` used for the degree-day estimates of {name} does not provide hourly forecasts. Historical sensors are not affected. Open [Heating & Cooling Degree Days]({url}), select the three-dot menu for this entry, and choose **Reconfigure** to select a weather entity with hourly forecasts or remove it.
